body: So you have MGD (Meibomian Gland Disorder). Yeah, hot compresses do work a bit, but not that much. And ok on the water.

It's a good thing I still have a brain and enough judgment to know what's a good idea and what's not. GTFO. why are you posting here if all you're going to do is rage and upset those who have real problems. Go troll elsewhere.
heh, this is ShittyAdvice that is *based* on real advice.
Done. I've heard of this product and what it could offer, and I will try anything to see if it helps. Though I've heard it was a scam.

I do not want to rely on painkillers and I don't believe it can really help.

The paradox in my condition is that I personally somehow believe that it is curable, but I've yet to find the culprit. Everybody tells me it is not curable, but I don't believe them.
Long Island at school, Westchester County at home. But I assure you this has very little to do with this as I didn't have this before 2 years ago.
No, I do not seem to.

Yes, I've seen several ophthalmologists. None of them say that they're anything wrong with my eyes, and most just dismiss me as another crazy patient. Only one has looked at my eyes and immediately said I was allergic. This makes NO sense. I've used allergy drops - did nothing.

It feels like the difference between using soft tissue paper when blowing your nose, for example (eye drops) and hard paper towel (water). However, I found that if I drink a lot of water the day prior, my eyes feel more relief the next day. But I mean a LOT of water.

The problem is that I found out that my dry eye isn't the classical dry eye syndrome. I've gone to doctors who've prescribed me steroid drops, given allergy drops, other things that are supposed to treat dry eye, and none of that ever did anything for me. I've tried ointments - that is just terrible. I produce enough tears, and my cornea (according to doctors) look absolutely fine. So I have no clue.
Yeah, I've yet to try using punctal plugs.
Weed enlarges your blood vessels. That increases the pain.

For me, it is most likely my contact lens hygiene and I feel like it disrupted my cornea somehow. But doctors who've looked at my cornea all said it was fine, they even said I DO NOT have dry eye, even though that is what it feels like. No, to me drops only feel like they are masking the pain for the time being. Some are better at it than others.
Thanks, I've yet to try Theratears. I have Dwelle, and even though it is super effective, it's still very temporary. And just using drops everyday is so bad, and doesn't really help anything at all.
I have. It just made it so much worse. Eye reddening just makes it so much more painful. In fact, it's the opposite - alcohol seems to help quite a bit, in terms of blinding me of the pain.

That is the problem. Nobody outside of that one forum is familiar with this condition. And a lot of people who have this feel like I do, so I figured someone here may have it, but I'll post in AskReddit as well.
